title: Huntik Foundation's motorbikes
summary: Motorbikes are used by the Huntik Foundation. They come in different colors and feature the Foundation's logo on the front.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Orange and green bikes were stored inside the [[Huntik Foundation's cargo jet]]. After being ambushed by [[Suits]] riding [[The Organization's motorbikes|bikes]] before landing in [[:Category:Baja California, Mexico|Baja California]], [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Den Fears]] used the bikes to jump off the plane and fight against the [[Suits]] on their own terrain. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}

{{Clear}}
